resumeRules: Require a new user request to resume exhaustive exploration; the historical IN_PROGRESS state is not authorization to continue now.
Preserve this baseline and existing source-hashes.json. Never overwrite the old baseline hashes with repaired or otherwise changed source bytes.

Before resuming baseline pending chunks, compare the baseline commit with the current committed tree and include staged, unstaged and untracked source files. Review changed, new, deleted and renamed files first as a separately recorded delta.
Record new comparison-point hashes and delta findings in separate artifacts. Do not mutate this historical snapshot or silently mark deleted baseline paths reviewed.

Carry forward unchanged fullyRead baseline coverage after identity verification; do not count it as a new reinspection. A hash check, metadata read or unchanged file listing is not a direct source review.

After the delta review, resume only the global remaining paths still applicable to the current tree. Account explicitly for moved or deleted baseline paths and exclude cross-chunk reads already credited globally.

Read and analyze the entire source body before adding fullyRead credit; preserve partial ranges and unread paths honestly. Keep audit coverage separate from the 39-finding repair and validation ledger.
